mapper.sql: F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AS formTemplateSn, F.CAT_SN AS catSn, C.CAT_NM AS catNm, F.FORM_VER_NO AS formVersion, FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS firstStepKey, F.FORM_SUBTTL AS subtitle, CAST(F.FORM_UI_META_JSON AS CHAR) AS uiMetaJson, F.FORM_ACTV_YN AS activeYn, F.FORM_USE_YN AS useYn
mapper.select: /* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findActiveFormHeaders */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.CAT_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.CAT_SORT_NO, C.CAT_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findActiveFormHeader */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND F.FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.CAT_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFormHeaderByTemplateSn */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findLatestFormHeaderByCategory */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY F.FORM_VER_NO DESC LIMIT 1

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findActiveFormHeaderByCategory */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND F.FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFormHeaderForUpdate */ SELECT FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL F JOIN CATEGORY C ON C.CAT_SN = F.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF FIRST_STEP ON FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIRST_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = F.FIRST_STEP_SN WHERE F.CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND F.FORM_USE_YN = 'Y' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(FORM_VER_NO), 0) FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL WHERE CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND FORM_USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL WHERE CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND FORM_USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF ( SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY, SVC_REQ_STEP_TTL, SVC_REQ_STEP_EXPLN, SVC_REQ_STEP_TYPE_CD, NEXT_STEP_SN, SVC_REQ_STEP_SNSTV_YN, SVC_REQ_STEP_PBLC_YN, SVC_REQ_STEP_SORT_NO, SVC_REQ_STEP_USE_YN, SVC_REQ_STEP_REG_ID, SVC_REQ_STEP_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{formTemplateSn}, #{step.stepKey}, #{step.title}, #{step.description}, #{step.type}, NULL, #{step.sensitiveYn}, #{step.publicYn}, #{step.sortNo}, 'Y', #{actorId}, #{actorId} )

INSERT INTO SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF ( SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY, SVC_REQ_FIELD_LABEL, SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD, SVC_REQ_FIELD_PH, SVC_REQ_FIELD_EXPLN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_REQ_YN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_DIGIT_YN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_SNSTV_YN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_PBLC_YN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_MAX_CNT, SVC_REQ_FIELD_SORT_NO, SVC_REQ_FIELD_UI_META_JSON, SVC_REQ_FIELD_USE_YN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_REG_ID, SVC_REQ_FIELD_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{formTemplateSn}, #{field.stepSn}, #{field.fieldKey}, #{field.label}, #{field.type}, #{field.placeholder}, #{field.description}, #{field.requiredYn}, #{field.requireDigitYn}, #{field.sensitiveYn}, #{field.publicYn}, #{field.maxSelections}, #{field.sortNo},
CAST(#{field.uiMetaJson} AS JSON) NULL , 'Y', #{actorId}, #{actorId} )

INSERT INTO SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_DEF ( SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, TARGET_STEP_SN, TARGET_FIELD_SN, SOURCE_STEP_SN, SOURCE_FIELD_STEP_SN, SOURCE_FIELD_SN, COMPARE_STEP_OPT_SN, COMPARE_FIELD_OPT_SN, RULE_OPERATOR_CD, RULE_ACTION_CD, SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SORT_NO, SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_USE_YN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_REG_ID, SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{formTemplateSn}, #{rule.targetStepSn}, #{rule.targetFieldSn}, #{rule.sourceStepSn}, #{rule.sourceFieldStepSn}, #{rule.sourceFieldSn}, #{rule.compareStepOptionSn}, #{rule.compareFieldOptionSn}, #{rule.operator}, #{rule.action}, #{rule.sortNo}, 'Y', #{actorId}, #{actorId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL SET FORM_ACTV_YN = 'N', FORM_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FORM_UPDT_ID = #{actorId} WHERE CAT_SN = #{catSn} AND FORM_ACTV_YN = 'Y' AND FORM_USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findSteps */ SELECT S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN AS stepSn, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS stepKey, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_TTL AS title, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_EXPLN AS description, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_TYPE_CD AS type, N.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS nextStepKey, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SNSTV_YN AS sensitiveYn, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_PBLC_YN AS publicYn, CAST(S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF S LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF N ON N.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = S.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND N.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = S.NEXT_STEP_SN WHERE S.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND S.SVC_REQ_STEP_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SORT_NO, S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findStepOptions */ SELECT O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN AS optionSn, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN AS stepSn, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_KEY AS optionKey, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_VAL AS value, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_LABEL AS label, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SUBTTL AS subtitle, N.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS nextStepKey, CAST(O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_DEF O LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF N ON N.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = O.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND N.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = O.NEXT_STEP_SN WHERE O.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY O.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SORT_NO, O.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFields */ SELECT D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN AS fieldSn, D.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN AS stepSn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY AS fieldKey, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_LABEL AS label, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD AS type, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_PH AS placeholder, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_EXPLN AS description, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_REQ_YN AS requiredYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_DIGIT_YN AS requireDigitYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SNSTV_YN AS sensitiveYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_PBLC_YN AS publicYn, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_MAX_CNT AS maxSelections, CAST(D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo, CAST(D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_UI_META_JSON AS CHAR) AS uiMetaJson FROM SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF D WHERE D.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SORT_NO, D.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFieldOptions */ SELECT O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN AS optionSn, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN AS fieldSn, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_KEY AS optionKey, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_VAL AS value, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_LABEL AS label, CAST(O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_DEF O WHERE O.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SORT_NO, O.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN

/* ServiceRequestFormMapper.findFieldRules */ SELECT R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SN AS ruleSn, R.TARGET_STEP_SN AS targetStepSn, R.TARGET_FIELD_SN AS targetFieldSn, R.SOURCE_STEP_SN AS sourceStepSn, R.SOURCE_FIELD_STEP_SN AS sourceFieldStepSn, R.SOURCE_FIELD_SN AS sourceFieldSn, R.COMPARE_STEP_OPT_SN AS compareStepOptionSn, R.COMPARE_FIELD_OPT_SN AS compareFieldOptionSn, SOURCE_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS sourceStepKey, SOURCE_FIELD_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS sourceFieldStepKey, SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY AS sourceFieldKey, SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FIELD_LABEL AS sourceFieldLabel, COALESCE(STEP_OPT.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_VAL, FIELD_OPT.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_VAL) AS compareValue, R.RULE_OPERATOR_CD AS operator, R.RULE_ACTION_CD AS action, CAST(R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SORT_NO AS SIGNED) AS sortNo FROM SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_DEF R LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF SOURCE_STEP ON SOURCE_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND SOURCE_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = R.SOURCE_STEP_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF SOURCE_FIELD ON SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND SOURCE_FIELD.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = R.SOURCE_FIELD_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF SOURCE_FIELD_STEP ON SOURCE_FIELD_STEP.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND SOURCE_FIELD_STEP.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = R.SOURCE_FIELD_STEP_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_DEF STEP_OPT ON STEP_OPT.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND STEP_OPT.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN = R.COMPARE_STEP_OPT_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_DEF FIELD_OPT ON FIELD_OPT.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FIELD_OPT.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN = R.COMPARE_FIELD_OPT_SN WHERE R.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn} AND R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SORT_NO, R.SVC_REQ_FIELD_RULE_SN
